summary.headline: Libra and Its Three Decans
summary.text: Description of Libra as an airy, sanguine, long-ascending sign, followed by the figures and stars co-rising with its three decans. Indian and Ptolemaic variants identify merchants, monstrous men, parts of the Great Bear, Virgo, the dragon, Ophiuchus, Centaur, ship, and Acherusian lake.
